reason: The README describes a DSH plugin whose primary purpose is orchestrating self-contained coding tasks delegated to a local Claude Code worker, with resumable sessions, background execution, tool permissions, and usage monitoring.

summaries.zh: 将自包含的编码子任务委派给本机 Claude Code 执行，并向 DSH 返回结果、会话状态和任务进度。
summaries.en: Delegates self-contained coding tasks to a local Claude Code process and returns results, session state, and task progress to DSH.

capabilities: delegates coding tasks to a local Claude Code CLI through the official Agent SDK
can allow Claude Code to use configured tools and modify files in a selected working directory
supports resumable sessions and background asynchronous jobs
reads local Claude subscription usage and authentication status through CLI data and cached usage files
supports configurable permission modes including an explicitly enabled bypass-permissions mode
